# Chang Thai Restaurant

> Authentic Thai restaurant in Hornby, Christchurch serving traditional street food, an extensive noodle menu, and rare Thai desserts. Known for fully customizable dishes, 7 spice levels, and a family-friendly, disability-accessible dining environment.

## Core Business Information
- **Website:** [https://changthai.co.nz/](https://changthai.co.nz/)
- **Address:** 21 Shands Road, Hornby, Christchurch 8042, New Zealand
- **Phone:** [+64 3 349 7069](tel:+6433497069)
- **Email:** changthaihb2024@gmail.com
- **Google Maps:** [View Location](https://maps.google.com/?q=21+Shands+Road,+Hornby,+Christchurch+8042)
- **Service Areas:** Hornby, Wigram, Prebbleton, HeiHei, Sockburn, Riccarton, Halswell, Rolleston and  Christchurch.

## Ordering & Reservations
- **Order Direct (Pickup/Delivery):** [ordering.changthai.co.nz](https://ordering.changthai.co.nz/)
- **Book a Table:** [booking.changthai.co.nz](https://booking.changthai.co.nz/)

- **DoorDash:** [Order on DoorDash](https://www.doordash.com/en-NZ/store/chang-thai-restaurant-christchurch-38168841/86875950/)

## Operating Hours
- **Lunch (Tue–Sun):** 11:30 AM – 2:30 PM
- **Dinner (Tue–Sun):** 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM
- **Winter Dinner Hours:** 4:30 PM – 8:30 PM
- **Closed:** Mondays and all Public Holidays

## Amenities & Dining Policies
- **Accessibility:** Fully wheelchair accessible with a dedicated disability-friendly bathroom.
- **Family Friendly:** High chairs available.
- **Parking:** Free on-site parking available for all customers.
- **Alcohol:** Fully licensed premises. BYO alcohol is permitted (corkage fee applies).
- **Catering:** Lunch catering is available for private events (call to arrange).

## Dietary & Customization
- **Spice Levels:** 7 levels available, ranging from Level 1 (No Chili) to Level 7 (Extra Hot Thai Style).
- **Ingredient Removals:** Peanuts, coriander, garlic, onions, or chili can be removed upon request.
- **Dietary Preferences:** Extensive vegetarian and vegan options using fresh vegetables and tofu. Many dishes are naturally gluten-free.
- **Protein Choices:** Chicken, Beef, Prawn, Tofu, Pork, or Mixed.

## Menu Highlights

### Most Popular Dishes
- **Traditional Pad Thai (D32):** Best seller. Thin rice noodles in homemade tamarind sauce, eggs, crushed peanuts, bean sprouts.
- **Authentic Green Curry (D42):** Coconut milk curry with kaffir lime, bamboo shoots, sweet Thai basil, capsicum.
- **Grilled Pork Neck with Sticky Rice:** Chef's special marinated slow-grilled pork neck.
- **Cashew Nut Stir-Fry (D25):** Roasted cashew nuts, capsicum, mushrooms, onions in special sauce.
- **Massaman Curry:** Coconut curry with potatoes, carrots, cinnamon, cardamom, crispy shallots, cashews.
- **Thai Basil Stir-Fry (Pad Krapow):** Holy basil paste, garlic, chili, beans, capsicum in oyster sauce.

### Authentic Noodles & Soups
- Khao Soi (Northern Thai curry noodles)
- Yentafo (Pink noodle)
- Pad See Ew (Stir-fried soy sauce noodles)
- Pork Tomyam Noodle & Dark Noodle Soup
- Tom Zabb (Spicy and sour pork soft bones soup)

### Unique Thai Desserts
- **Bua Loy:** Rice balls in sweet coconut milk
- **Longan Sticky Rice:** With coconut milk
- **Sago & Corn:** With coconut milk
- **Red Ruby:** Water chestnut and jackfruit in coconut milk

### Entrees & House Specials
- **Appetizers:** Summer rolls, satay chicken, fish cakes, sago dumplings, prawn croquettes, crab rangoon.
- **Specials:** Yum-Naam (Fermented pork & crispy rice salad), Fried sea bass variations (herbs/chili/salad), Deep fried Ling fish fillets, Orange chicken.
